name: Izumi Ichika
source:
"I will do my best for the shop!"

An employee at the cafe "Baurista". She is highly popular with her customers because of her great attention to detail.

Suddenly, the store manager put her in charge of searching for candidates for the handsome men's tournament...

She likes to make coffee and sometimes helps in the kitchen.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/irohanihoheto/%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9-1]offiical website[/url]]
